title: Gemini CLI Shutdown Announcement
description: Google announced that Gemini CLI will be shut down for free, Pro, and Ultra users on June 18, 2026. The tool will be replaced by Antigravity CLI. This affects CI/CD pipelines, shell scripts, and automation using the CLI.

community_feedback.quote: Community discussion raised concerns about impact on CI/CD pipelines and automation workflows.

title: Claude Opus 4.8 Launch with Dynamic Workflows
description: Anthropic launched Claude Opus 4.8 with new dynamic workflows feature for large-scale problems and fast mode. Claude Code also added post-session hooks, safe mode for troubleshooting, /cd command for directory navigation, and tightened MCP policy.

title: Session Folders and Mid-Session Mode Toggles
description: Devin introduced Session Folders for organizing sessions in the sidebar with drag-and-drop support. Users can now switch between Ultra and Fast modes mid-session using !ultra and !fast commands in Slack.

description: Devin updated the organization membership page tab from
for clarity, part of June 10, 2026 improvements including session folders and mid-session mode toggles.

title: Organizations for Cursor Enterprise
description: Enterprise customers can now manage multiple Cursor teams from one place, with different security, governance, budget, and feature controls for each. Organizations serve as the top-level container for company identity and administration.

title: Agents Window in VS Code Stable (Preview)
description: GitHub Copilot introduced the Agents window in VS Code Stable as a preview, providing an agent-first experience focused on completing tasks rather than just editing code. Includes remote agents support and session sync capabilities.

title: Bugbot Performance Improvements
description: Bugbot is now over 3x faster (average review time reduced from ~5 minutes to ~90 seconds), 22% cheaper, and finds 10% more bugs per review. These gains are powered by Composer 2.5 training improvements.

title: Design Mode and Canvas Enhancements
description: Design Mode now available in canvases for faster UI editing. Context usage reports show interactive breakdowns of token usage. Multi-select elements and voice input capabilities added for browser interactions.

title: Cursor SDK Updates: Custom Tools and Auto-Review
description: TypeScript and Python SDKs now support custom tools via function definitions, auto-review routing for headless runs, JSONL and custom stores for persistence, and nested subagents. Reliability and performance improvements included.

title: Pre-Commit Review with /review Command
description: Users can now run Bugbot and Security Review with /review before pushing code. /review-bugbot and /review-security allow direct agent access. Syncs with GitHub and GitLab to skip redundant reviews.

title: Air-Gapped BYOK and Expanded Language Model Controls
description: Bring-your-own-key models can now run in isolated environments without GitHub authentication. Added configurable utility models, reasoning effort controls, and improved token visibility for BYOK models.

title: Terminal Safety and Integrated Browser Enhancements
description: Expanded terminal output compression, command risk assessment, sensitive prompt protection, and an integrated browser with device emulation and screenshot capabilities for testing website responsiveness.

title: Usage-Based Billing Transition and Price Increases
description: Starting June 1, 2026, GitHub moved Copilot from request-based billing to usage-based billing (AI Credits). Price increases of up to 9x for some models, removal of Copilot subsidies, and all features including code review now consuming AI Credits.

community_feedback.quote: End of an Era - Copilot's new pricing model just quietly ended the vibe
Billing shock when seeing new usage-based costs, particularly for large codebases
Users questioned why they should pay the same amount but be forced to use it by month-end
Cost updates described as brutal with 9x price increases for certain models

title: Code Review Billing Model Change
description: GitHub Copilot code review began consuming GitHub Actions minutes starting June 1, 2026, changing how code review usage is allocated and billed for enterprise customers.

title: Gemini 2.0 Models Shutdown
description: Google shut down Gemini 2.0 models (gemini-2.0-flash and gemini-2.0-flash-001) on June 1, 2026. This affects users relying on these specific model versions.
